name: Green function
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中用离散基本响应表示基础结构动力行为的函数。
usage_overview: 用于以结构的单位脉冲响应为基础，通过叠加计算界面荷载引起的振动，表达基础结构在荷载作用下的动力响应。

complete_examples.text: At the same time, the infrastructure is expressed the as Green function in discrete form, and infrastructure is coupled with the train-track system by the interface interaction force.
The Green function is obtained by solving the dynamic response of the system under impulse load.
